title: BSP Regulatory Reporting & Compliance Automation
thesis: Snowflake processes regulatory documents via Textract + AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT, orchestrates report generation with Step Functions-equivalent Task Graphs, and provides Cortex Search on BSP circulars — transforming manual compliance into automated pipelines

talking_points: 210 regulatory reports due this quarter — 38 reports due within next 2 weeks.
Current readiness: 82% of reports passing all validation rules.
14 outstanding BSP exam findings — 5 past remediation deadline.
tabs.call_out: 38 reports due in 2 weeks — 5 BSP findings past remediation deadline

transition.line: Let's look at which reports are at risk and how to prioritize.

talking_points: ML.CLASSIFICATION predicts 12 reports likely to fail BSP validation this cycle.
Top failure reasons: reconciliation gaps in DOSRI report (₱4.2M unresolved), CAMEL ratio calculation errors.
Task Graph automates: GL extract → validate → generate → reconcile — 4 hours vs 3 days manual.
show: Show predicted failure reports in amber/red
tabs.call_out: 12 reports predicted to fail — fix data quality NOW, not at deadline

transition.line: Predictive quality saves deadline panic. Let's check circular compliance.

talking_points: AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT processed 450 BSP circulars — extracting requirements, deadlines, impact areas.
New circular 1186: enhanced cyber risk reporting — effective Jan 2025, 3 new data fields required.
Cortex Search: compliance team queries 'What does BSP require for DOSRI lending limits?' — instant answer.
show: Show parsed circular with extracted requirements
tabs.call_out: 450 BSP circulars searchable in natural language — instant compliance answers

transition.line: Let the CCO ask the system directly.

talking_points: Atty. Aquino asks: 'Which reports failed validation last quarter?'
Cortex Analyst: 8 reports failed — DOSRI, CAMEL, and liquidity coverage most frequent.
Follow-up: 'What does BSP Circular 1085 say about capital adequacy reporting?' — searches 450 circulars.
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + BSP circular search

talking_points: Textract → AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT for circulars. Step Functions → Task Graphs for report generation.
Full pipeline: GL extract → validate → generate → reconcile → file — automated end-to-end.
BSP supervises 500+ banks. This automates 210 reports per quarter for one universal bank.
tabs.call_out: Regulatory reporting automated — Task Graphs replace Step Functions

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Philippine regulatory compliance.
